target_rule: k=1+int(SHA256(UTF8(seed+':'+p+':'+j)).hexdigest(),16) mod (q-1), j=0,1,2; require distinct targets within each cell and none in prior six fixtures; construct T=k*Qbar outside timing and pass only T to solvers
candidate_order: all nonzero (a,b) in [-B,B]^2 sorted by frozen 128-bit Decimal height score then (a,b)
dedup_rule: after source lambda is ready, scan full sorted list before target input; keep only first label for each nonzero residue (a+lambda*b) mod q; discard identity and later duplicate residues; charge ordering and filtering as setup
arms: baseline rational scan and deduplicated rational scan call the same pinned rational solver with full or filtered label sequence; rho calls the same pinned deterministic Floyd solver on the identical public point
online_interval: start before first target-dependent rational construction or rho walk and stop after scalar and independent public-point verification; include failed candidates/restarts; exclude source-lambda discovery, curve/pairing/label/filter setup, fixture construction, process startup
status_policy: retain verified, candidate_cap_exhausted, rho_cap_exhausted, wall_cap_exhausted, and error rows with started/completed work and online interval
claim_boundary: ordinary-host diagnostic on newly seeded same-point triples, with source lambda supplied; no Tier 0/1 speedup promotion; cold setup excludes source-lambda discovery and remains separate
